en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town set in a river valley. In the foreground a river curves around a grassy area with rocks and trees along its banks. Behind it stands a row of modest, tightly packed houses with gabled roofs. Rising above the town on a hill is a large historic castle complex with multiple wings, towers, and fortified walls, as well as a tall church spire. Industrial chimneys are visible on the right side in the background. The whole scene suggests an old fortified city overlooking a small river, photographed from an elevated vantage point.
